text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Wonderful.
Just thinking back on it makes me... fufu.
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood. What happened?
You're in high spirits. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I simply cannot forget the monument I saw displayed at the estate of my father's acquaintance the other day.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "A deep crimson representing a burning heart... Unrefined yet meticulously calculated, a form reminiscent of a solid block of iron..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is the very concept of strength made manifest.
Just watching it made my heart surge with inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Now, shall we get on with our training?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That was supposed to be a cemented carbide iron ball I bought before. Crushing it so easily is quite a shock... but it seems she had a fulfilling vacation and is well-rested.
